sentences.text:
2.The present writ petition is filed praying for a writ of mandamus, to direct the respondents to compute and pay to the petitioners for Acquisition of their lands of 4 acres 14 cents in S.No.238/1A situated at Karanai Revenue Village, Cheyyar Taluk, Tiruvannamalai District, under the Tamil Nadu Acquisition of Land for Industrial Purpose Act, 1997, covered under Award Notice of the 4th Respondent in Na.Ka.No.A2/323/2021 dated 03.02.2025, the benefits under the provisions of sections 26 to 30 and also Chapter V & I, II Schedule of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and also to dispose of the common representation of the petitioners dated 20.06.2023, 01.07.2024 and 03.03.2025.
3.After submitting for a brief while

, learned Special Government Pleader would submit that the communication dated 03.02.2025 wherein it was stated that in respect of S.No.238/1A, the persons claiming https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 20/06/2025 05:56:04 pm ) ownership shall obtain approval from the Revenue Divisional Officer and thereafter, may approach the Principal District Judge, Tiruvannamalai.

4.It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that they may be granted liberty to obtain approval from the Revenue Divisional Officer and thereafter, approach the Principal District Judge,
Tiruvannamalai, in support of its claim for computation and payment of compensation under the Tamil Nadu Acquisition of Land for Industrial Purposes Act, 1997 and under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

sentences.text: 6. In view thereof, the writ petition stands disposed of.

It is open to the petitioner's to urge before the appropriate authority regarding the entitlement under the above said enactments and the same would be https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 20/06/2025 05:56:04 pm ) decided by the appropriate authority in accordance with law, after affording the petitioner and any other interested parties a reasonable opportunity of hearing.

It is made clear that this Court has not expressed any opinion on the applicability or entitlement of the petitioner's right in terms of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013.
